cohort: 312 newborns with validated umbilical cord blood pH values, from a larger cohort of 1655 newborns at a regional hospital in southeastern Spain between January and December 2019
finding: Induction of labor, vaginal delivery, and longer total labor duration were associated with acidosis (pH < 7.20) in the umbilical artery at birth.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was associated with lower umbilical artery pH at birth compared to cesarean delivery.
